title: Find Every Portfolio Company of an Investor, Then the People Inside
summary: How go-to-market teams and their coding agents list every portfolio company of a VC or accelerator, then the decision-makers at each one, with two Cargo actions: an investor-filtered company search and a people search by domain. Commands, prices and returned fields.
body_markdown:
**To find every portfolio company of an investor, run Cargo’s` theirStack.searchCompanies` with the investor’s name in` company_investors_partial_match_or` : each company comes back with its domain, stage and full investor list, at 0.5 credits a company. Then pass the domains to` aiArk.searchPeople` to list the decision-makers inside them, at 0.05 credits a person.**


This is a go-to-market list built around a relationship rather than a firmographic filter: an investor who already backs a customer of yours, an accelerator batch, a fund whose companies share a stack. The list is also what you take to the investor when you ask for introductions. The[find-portfolio-companies](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/find-portfolio-companies) skill runs the same job.


## What it costs, from the code#


Step Action Credits


1. The portfolio` theirStack.searchCompanies` 0.5 per company returned


2. The people inside` aiArk.searchPeople` 0.05 per person returned


Both bill per record returned, so` limit` is the bill. A 140-company portfolio is 70 credits; five decision-makers at each is another 35.


## Run it#


### 1. Install and sign in


shellscript


```text
npm   install   -g   @cargo-ai/cli
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com                   # sends a code
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com   --code   123456     # creates the account on first use


```


No browser step, so a coding agent can run this itself. A new account starts with 100 free credits and no card.


### 2. Pull the portfolio


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"theirStack","actionSlug":"searchCompanies"}'   \
--data   '{"fields":{"company_investors_partial_match_or":["Sequoia"]},"limit":20}'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


` company_investors_partial_match_or` keeps companies where any investor name contains the text, so` Sequoia` also catches` Sequoia Capital India` . Use` company_investors_or` for an exact name. For Y Combinator,` "only_yc_companies": true` filters on the batch directly, and each company comes back with its` yc_batch` . Narrow further in the same` fields` object:` funding_stage_or` ,` min_employee_count` ,` company_country_code_or` .


Pull 20 first, read them, then raise` limit` (up to 500 per call) once the list looks right.


### 3. Find the people inside


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"aiArk","actionSlug":"searchPeople"}'   \
--data   '{
"companyInfo": {"domain_or": ["northwind.example", "tailspin.example"]},
"jobRole": {"seniority_or": ["c_suite", "vp", "director"], "department_or": ["sales", "sales_operations"]},
"limit": 50
}'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


` seniority_or` and` department_or` take fixed values (` founder` ,` c_suite` ,` vp` ,` director` ,` head` ,` manager` , and departments such as` sales` ,` marketing` ,` finance` ,` operations` ). Titles in plain text go in` jobRole.title_or` .` limit` goes up to 2,000.


## What comes back#


Action Fields


` theirStack.searchCompanies`` name` ,` domain` ,` linkedin_url` ,` investors` ,` funding_stage` ,` last_funding_round_date` ,` employee_count`


` aiArk.searchPeople`` full_name` ,` title` ,` linkedin_url` ,` company_name` ,` company_domain` ,` country`


The people search returns no email. To reach them, the next step is[finding and verifying their work emails](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/find-and-verify-work-emails-at-scale) .


## Frequently asked questions#


Run theirStack.searchCompanies with fields.only_yc_companies set to true. Each company comes back with its yc_batch, so you can keep one batch.


Yes. The find-portfolio-companies skill runs the same job on People Data Labs’ SQL company search, peopleDataLabs.queryCompanies, at 3 credits per company returned and up to 100 per call.


You can, with firecrawl.scrape at 0.05 credits a page, but most portfolio pages list logos and names, not domains, and miss exits and older investments. A search on the investor field returns domains you can pass straight to the people search.
